choose.installer_text: Seld asebded, ad t-tafeḍ deg umuɣ n usenker.
choose.program_text: Tzemreḍ ad t-tsekreḍ ula mebla asebded.
pick.question_manage: D acu ara yilin deg umuɣ n usenker?
pick.question_install: D acu ara nernu ɣer umuɣ n usenker?
status.finish_in_installer: Fak asebded deg usfaylu n umsebded. Syin ad nkemmel da.
status.downloading: Asader n yiferdisen ilaqen… (tikkelt tamenzut kan)
error.not_found: Ur d-nufi ara ahil. Ahat yettwakkes; ales asebded-is.
error.no_exe: Ur d-nufi acemma ara yettusekren deg wahil-a.
error.runtime_missing: Ixuṣ yiwen n uferdis i ilaqen i usekker n yihilen. Leqqem anagraw deg Sloth Center.
error.not_started: {name} ur yekker ara. Ahat ahil-a ur iteddu ara deg unagraw-a, neɣ afaylu yexser.
error.nothing_installed: Ur d-nufi ara ahil yebdden. Ahat asebded yegzem; ɛreḍ tikkelt nniḍen.
anticheat.blocked: {game} isseqdac asemmesten mgal tixxidin {system}, ur yeǧǧi ara urar ad iteddu deg Linux. Mačči d aselkim-ik i d sebba, ur nezmir ara ad t-nezgel. Nesḥassef, urar-a ur yettwaurar ara da.
anticheat.maybe: {game} isseqdac asemmesten mgal tixxidin {system}. Deg Linux iteddu kan ma sirgen-t yimesnulfuyen n wurar. Ma yella urar ur yekker ara neɣ ak-d-yessufeɣ, ahat d ayagi i d sebba. Wali ma yella lqem n Steam i wurar-a.
